thread:
ian: heads up — started seeing duplicate SAML sessions for a handful of orgs after the idp rotated keys overnight. users get provisioned, then deprovisioned, then provisioned again in a loop.

maria: can you paste a snippet of the assertion validation error from the logs? sounds like an assertion/cookie mismatch.

ian: logs show repeated failures around assertion validation and a KMS decrypt error. here's the relevant tail: 
```
ERROR 2026-03-20T02:13:07Z auth: validate_assertion: assertion_id=abc123 user=alice example.com KMSDecrypt failed: InvalidCiphertextException: encryption context mismatch (expected {team_id: 42, env: prod}, got {team: 42})
WARN  2026-03-20T02:13:07Z scim: deprovision loop detected for user alice@example.com
```

devon: that InvalidCiphertextException with "encryption context mismatch" screams key alias/context mismatch after key rotation. did the idp rotate keys and change context keys? @sso-bot any automated rotation events?

sso-bot: automated-idp-rotation: detected SAML metadata change for idp://example-idp — key rollover event at 2026-03-20T01:58:12Z. Notified teams: eng-security, eng-sso.

maria: if the idp started signing with a new key but our decryption context still expects the old context shape, KMS will reject. check KMS encryption_context we store on assertions. example from vault: `kms_context = {"team_id":"42","env":"prod"}`. can you dump the last stored context for that assertion id?

ian: grabbing from logs/db now. stored context for assertion abc123: `{\"team\":\"42\"}` — looks like old idp used `team` key not `team_id`. somehow during the rotation the idp changed the context key name.

devon: that explains it. KMS decrypt compares map keys exactly. we need to accept both shapes during a rollout. quick mitigation: update assertion validator to try both contexts when decrypting (fallback), and add a small audit event when fallback happens. that will stop the deprov/provision churn.

ian: on it. pushing a patch to try both contexts and instrument an audit log. will also add a feature flag so we can revert.

oncall: FYI this is causing deprovision retries and noisy alerts in support queue. can we run a targeted re-run for affected orgs after the fix? I'll open an incident ticket and runbook.

maria: for long-term, add a pre-rotation checklist: confirm idp rotation preserves encryption context schema or publish a compatibility window. also add a KMS decrypt metric to alert on spikes of InvalidCiphertextException.

devon: short commands to re-run deprovision for an org (limited to affected users):
```
# re-run scim deprovision for org
./scripts/scim-reconcile --org example-org --since 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z --dry-run
./scripts/scim-reconcile --org example-org --since 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z
```

ian: patch deployed to staging, fallback logic added. will roll to prod after 30m smoke. instrumented audit event: `sso.decrypt_context_fallback` with details.

sso-bot: deploy pipeline: staging rollout for service sso-auth started by ian at 2026-03-20T03:01:12Z.

oncall: opened incident INC-2026-315; assigned eng-sso and support on-call. I'll run the re-run once ian confirms prod patch.

ian: prod patch rolled. smoke looks good — no more deprov loops in the last 15m. running targeted reconcile for 7 affected orgs now.

maria: thanks. can we also add a check in the idp onboarding flow that validates encryption context keys shape and warns on mismatch? ticket please.

devon: filing a follow-up: add onboarding validation + rotation runbook + KMS metric + unit test that simulates context key change.

oncall: closing incident when reconciles finish. otherwise :thumbsup:.

ian: will follow up with the idp contact to request consistent schema next rotations. added note to runbook.

maria: nice containment — good catching this quickly. :tada:
